# terrakube_federated_credential (Resource)

Create a federated credential. Federated credentials establish a trust relationship between Terrakube and an external identity provider (such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Azure AD), allowing tokens issued by that provider to authenticate against Terrakube.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "terrakube_federated_credential" "github_actions" {
  name       = "GitHub Actions"
  issuer_url = "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com"
  audience   = "terrakube-audience"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `audience` (String) Audience expected in tokens issued by the identity provider. Example: "terrakube-audience"
- `issuer_url` (String) Issuer URL of the external identity provider. Example: "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com"
- `name` (String) Federated credential name. Example: "GitHub Actions"

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Federated credential ID

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Federated credential can be imported with id
terraform import terrakube_federated_credential.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
